items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: And Jimi Hendrix. Yeah, you’d like to have been a part of that crowd.

ctx.x: I would have loved to have seen Cannonball. Because a lot of those live shows, you just wish you were there, you know. Like you hear the crowd and you say yeah, I wish I was there watching that. And Jimi Hendrix. Yeah, you’d like to have been a part of that crowd. Yeah. I would say.
What period of John Coltrane do you especially like?
